options.content: Private fill totals over the selected time range. Average prices are quantity-weighted. Spread PnL is paired volume times average spread; inventory PnL marks unpaired fill volume to the latest reference price using the dominant side's average fill price; fee PnL is negative reported fill fees.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_diagnostics AS (
  SELECT e.payload, e.exchange
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
interval_mark AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS mark_price
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT gates.key AS role_exchange,
         gates.value->>'role' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(d.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS gates
  UNION
  SELECT d.exchange AS role_exchange,
         'local' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  WHERE d.exchange IS NOT NULL
),
fills AS (
  SELECT
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS fee
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND qty > 0) AS bid_qty,
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND qty > 0) AS ask_qty,
    SUM(fee) AS total_fee,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS bid_avg_price,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS ask_avg_price
  FROM fills
)
SELECT ($__timeTo())::timestamptz AS "time",
       COALESCE(bid_qty, 0.0) AS value
FROM agg
LEFT JOIN interval_mark ON TRUE

  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0), NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(d.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS mark_price
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
),
role_exchanges AS (
  SELECT gates.key AS role_exchange,
         gates.value->>'role' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(d.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS gates
  UNION
  SELECT d.exchange AS role_exchange,
         'local' AS role
  FROM latest_diagnostics d
  WHERE d.exchange IS NOT NULL
),
fills AS (
  SELECT
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'fee', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS fee
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND qty > 0) AS bid_qty,
    SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND qty > 0) AS ask_qty,
    SUM(fee) AS total_fee,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'bid' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS bid_avg_price,
    SUM(price * qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0)
      / NULLIF(SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE side = 'ask' AND price IS NOT NULL AND qty > 0), 0.0) AS ask_avg_price
  FROM fills
)
SELECT ($__timeTo())::timestamptz AS "time",
       -COALESCE(total_fee, 0.0) AS value
FROM agg
LEFT JOIN interval_mark ON TRUE

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
